question: How do I create a new document in the system?
expected_answer: Sign in as an admin or editor, go to Documents > New, fill the title and content, then send to review and publish.

question: ¿Cómo cambio el idioma de la interfaz?
expected_answer: Cada usuario puede elegir su idioma en la pantalla de configuración personal. El admin también define un idioma por defecto en tenant_config.

question: What happens when my monthly AI budget runs out?
expected_answer: Chat blocks new paid AI requests with the AI_BUDGET_EXCEEDED error. Document viewing and management workflows still work. An admin can raise the budget.

question: How does retrieval work in v2?
expected_answer: Vector kNN and BM25 are fused with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, then a cross-encoder reranker produces the final top-K chunks.

question: Can I use Claude instead of OpenAI?
expected_answer: Yes. tenant_config.llm_provider can be set to 'anthropic' with a model like claude-3-5-sonnet, and the system uses Anthropic's API for chat completions.

question: How are images in articles stored?
expected_answer: Images upload to MinIO (S3-compatible) and the HTML references them by relative URL. The sanitizer rejects base64-inline data URIs.

question: ¿Qué tipos de archivos puedo importar?
expected_answer: Se pueden importar PDF y DOCX hasta 10 MB. El sistema extrae el texto, opcionalmente describe las imágenes con un VLM, y vos terminás el formato en el editor.

question: Como funciona o feedback nos artigos?
expected_answer: Cada artigo permite reações ±1 e favoritos por usuário. Além disso, cada resposta do chat aceita feedback (joinha cima/baixo) com comentário opcional.

question: How do I categorize an article by product and module?
expected_answer: Admin defines 'product' and 'module' dimensions in Configuration. When editing a document, assign one or more values per dimension. Chat then filters by ?dim_product=X&dim_module=Y.

question: What is the difference between admin, editor, and viewer roles?
expected_answer: Admin manages users, dimensions, and config; editor can create/edit drafts but not publish; viewer only reads docs and chats.

question: ¿Cómo creo una API key para integrar con otro sistema?
expected_answer: En manage-web, sección API keys, click en Nueva. Definí scopes (chat, ingest, admin), rate limit y opcionalmente presupuesto mensual. El secreto se muestra una sola vez; copialo.

question: Does the chat support follow-up questions?
expected_answer: Yes. Each conversation has a session_id; a cheap LLM rewrites follow-up questions using prior turns to drive retrieval and cache lookups.

question: How do I see what articles users search for but find no answer?
expected_answer: The unresolved questions dashboard in manage-web clusters questions that got no citation or negative feedback, suggesting content to create.

question: What's the cache strategy?
expected_answer: Semantic cache by (corpus, access_scope_hash, filter_hash, question_embedding). Hit if cosine similarity >= 0.90. TTL 24h. Invalidated when a cited document is modified or archived.

question: How is observability turned on?
expected_answer: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.observability.yaml --profile observability up. OTel-collector receives traces/metrics/logs from .NET and FastAPI and forwards to Tempo, Prometheus, Loki, Grafana.

question: What if I want to host the embedding model locally instead of OpenAI?
expected_answer: Set tenant_config.embedding_provider = 'tei' and point embedding_base_url at a TEI sidecar serving BAAI/bge-m3. Schema dim stays at 1024.

question: ¿Cómo restauro un documento archivado?
expected_answer: Desde la lista de documentos, filtrá por estado Archivado, abrí el documento y usá la acción Restaurar. Vuelve a Borrador y requiere pasar revisión y publicación nuevamente.

question: Can I limit who sees specific articles?
expected_answer: Yes. Document permissions assign documents to groups. Users belong to groups; only chunks of docs they have access to are retrievable. v1.1+ can also filter by dimension value.

question: Como o sistema decide se faz cache de uma resposta?
expected_answer: O sistema só escreve em cache se a resposta tem pelo menos uma citação válida. Recusas e respostas 'não sei' não são cacheadas.

question: What happens when I publish a document that has imports failing?
expected_answer: Publish triggers FastAPI indexing. If indexing fails, the document stays In Review with a safe error. Operator can retry indexing from the management UI.
